content_preview:
name: OpenClaw Skills Test Suite

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop, feature/* ]
    paths:
      - 'skills/**'
      - '.github/workflows/skills-test.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
    paths:
      - 'skills/**'
  schedule:
    # 每日凌晨2点运行
    - cron: '0 18 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      test_type:
        description: '测试类型'
        required: true
        default: 'all'
        type: choice
        options:
          - all
          - critical
